name: mordant
description: Funded protection for conflicting pledges on tokenized receivables.

scripts.test:unit: pnpm build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.cleanverse-tests.json && NODE_PATH=./test/stubs node --test .cleanverse-test-dist/src/lib/cleanverse/cleanverse.test.js .cleanverse-test-dist/src/lib/contracts/abi-parity.test.js .cleanverse-test-dist/src/lib/contracts/pledge.test.js .cleanverse-test-dist/src/lib/contracts/read-vault.test.js .cleanverse-test-dist/src/lib/evidence/chain-config.test.js .cleanverse-test-dist/src/lib/evidence/evidence.test.js .cleanverse-test-dist/src/lib/mordant/scenario.test.js
scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && pnpm test:unit && forge test --root contracts -vvv
scripts.validate: eslint . && tsc --noEmit && pnpm test:unit && forge test --root contracts -vvv && forge fmt --root contracts --check && pnpm evidence:cleanverse && pnpm secret:scan && next build --webpack
